The all-in-one communication solution for schools

Everyday communications and emergency solutions for K-12 schools

text.text:
Equip teachers, administrators, security personnel and other educational professionals to communicate quickly and broadly

Stryker's school communication solutions equip staff to communicate quickly and broadly everyday - helping to improve security for schools and protect students in an emergency.

Product highlights

  • Voice calling
  • Secure messaging
  • Notifications
  • Panic button

standaloneimage_copy.alt: teacher wearing Sync Badge talking with two young students

text.text:
Communicate intuitively with individuals or groups

Go beyond walkie-talkies and panic button point solutions to stay connected from the classroom and elsewhere

Stryker’s lightweight, wearable Smartbadge and Sync Badge bring together hands-free voice calling, secure messaging, notifications and a wearable panic button in one device.

  • Say, “OK Vocera” to wake up the device and initiate a conversation without needing to know names or numbers.
  • Enable administrators, teachers and school resource officers to stay connected from the classroom or elsewhere.
  • Get a near-real time directory view of teachers, administrative staff and resource officers, even across multiple campuses.

standaloneimage.alt: School resource officer wearing Vocera Smartbadge

text.text:
Create a communication hub for school security 
and safety

Request help quickly

Our solutions integrate with campus security technologies to help speed law enforcement and EMT response and allow broad communication in the event of a threat.

  • Press the panic button to quickly and discreetly send information using a one-way communication channel to security personnel.
  • Broadcast to a group or everyone in a facility to follow a protocol such as lockdown or shelter in place.
  • Teachers and staff can directly call 911, and security supervisors can contact school resource officers directly.

Create a quieter environment for teaching
and learning

Fast, reliable education communication solution for teachers and administrators

Help reduce classroom disruptions from overhead paging, intercoms, and/or walkie-talkies and give teachers more control over communication.

  • Users can call each other directly.
  • Use Do Not Disturb (DND) to allow focus on an activity.
  • Communications can be designed to automatically escalate, and DND mode can be overridden in an emergency.

curatedcta.CTAImageAltText: Teacher wearing Smartbadge interacting with class

text.text:
Smart communication to help enhance school safety

Discover how wearable, voice-activated technology is helping schools facilitate everyday communication and emergency response. With one device, staff can call, message, broadcast and activate a panic alert—without reaching for a phone.

curatedcta_copy.CTAImageAltText: School staff wearing Smartbadge while welcoming students entering through door

text_copy.text:
Smart emergency communication that goes beyond a panic button

Effective school safety starts with fast, clear communication. But traditional panic alarms can only go so far. That’s why it’s important to consider adopting mobile, two-way communication tools that help staff respond quickly and stay connected.
